ext.connect.title: Huza mushakisha
ext.connect.sub: Imbuga zerekanwa muri iyi mushakisha zibarirwa kuri konti yanyu ya PR.SOCIAL. Guhuza bisaba kanda rimwe ku rubuga.
ext.connect.wait: Emeza uhuza ku paji yafunguye. Kode izarangira mu {time}.
ext.connect.fail: Nta mahuza na pr.social. Mugenzure interineti yanyu, mongere mugerageze.
ext.connect.no.tasks: Mushakisha ishobora guhuzwa nyuma y'imirimo {need} byemejwe. Rangiza imirimo kuri pr.social, hanyuma wongere wemeze uhuza.
ext.connect.no.devices: Konti yanyu isanzwe ifite ibikoresho {max} byahujwe. Gutandukanya kimwe kuri pr.social mu Bikoresho, hanyuma wongere wemeze uhuza.
ext.connect.no.device: Iyi mushakisha ntishobora guhuzwa. Imishakisho igenzurwa na porogaramu ntiyemewe.
ext.connect.no.restricted: Konti yanyu yakumiriwe. Mushakisha ishobora guhuzwa igihe ibyo kumirwa bizakurwaho.
ext.connect.no.off: Kwagura gusura imbuga ntikiraboneka kuri konti yanyu.
ext.start.hint: Imbuga zifungurirwa mu idirishya ryazo ryihariye. Mugume rigaragara kuri ecran: murishobora kurigabanya, murishyira mu nguni, mugakomeza gukora mu yandi madirishya. Iyo rimanuwe cyangwa ritwikiriwe n'andi madirishya, kwerekana birahagarara.
ext.perm.why: Kugira ngo yerekane imbuga, kwagura gusaba Chrome uburenganzira bwo gufungura urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose mu idirishya ryacyo. Ntikoresha ubu burenganzira mu bindi.
ext.pause.hidden.sub: Kwerekana bizakomeza idirishya ry'imbuga rigarutse kuri ecran.
ext.gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL yafunze iyi mushakisha. Mwandikire Ubufasha kugira ngo mumenye impamvu n'icyo mukora.
ext.gate.update.sub: Ubu verisiyo ntigikora. Buto iri hasi izafungura urupapuro rw'verisiyo nshya kandi ikerekane uko yashyirwaho.
ext.gate.closed.sub: Kwagura kwisuzumira ubwako, bityo nta kintu mukeneye gukora.
ext.off.sub: Yakuweho kuri konti yanyu kuri pr.social. Mushobora kongera kuyihuza mukoresheje kode nshya.
ext.limits.hour.hint: Imbuga mushakisha ishobora kwerekana mu isaha imwe
ext.money: Amafaranga mwinjije agera ku mafaranga mufite mu minota mike. Hano aragaragara ako kanya.
ext.stage.title: Idirishya rya PR Surf
ext.stage.sub: Imbuga zifungurwa hano ubwazo. Komeza iri dirishya ku ecran: ushobora kuriyigabanya, kurishyira mu nguni, ugakomeza gukora mu yindi madirishya. Iyo iri dirishya rigabanyijwe cyangwa ritwikiriwe n'andi yose, rirahagarara. Ushobora kurihagarika muri extension.
ext.wait.offline.sub: Kugaragaza bizakomeza byikora interineti igarutse. Imbuga zamaze kugaragara ntizizatakara.
ext.wait.empty.sub: Imbuga nshya zigaragara igihe abamamaza batumije gusurwa. Kwagura bizongera bigenzure byikora saa {time}.
ext.pause.closed.sub: Kugaragaza birahagarara kugeza igihe idirishya rizongera gufungurwa. Imbuga zamaze kugaragara ntizizatakara.
ext.pause.covered.sub: Imbuga zibarwa gusa igihe idirishya ryazo rigaragara. Kugaragaza bizakomeza igihe rizongera kuboneka ku ecran.
ext.pause.check_missed.sub: Ikibazo “Muri hano?” ntikibonye igisubizo mu gihe gikwiye. Kanda “Gukomeza” kugira ngo dusubukure.
ext.check.sub: Kanda buto iri hasi kugira ngo mukomeze. Kugeza mwashubije, kugaragaza biba bihagaze.
ext.stopped.restart: Kugaragaza byahagaze igihe Chrome yongeye gutangira. Mongere mutangire kugaragaza igihe mwiteguye.
ext.net.stale: Nta sano na pr.social. Imibare iri hasi ishobora kuba itakiri ukuri.
ext.why.CRASH: Urupapuro rwahagaze gukora, bityo kwagura byafunguye tabu nshya kandi bikomeza kugaragaza.
ext.why.SHORT: Urupapuro rwamaze igihe gito cyane kuri ecran. Mukomeze idirishya ry'imbuga rifunguye kandi rigaragare.
ext.why.EARLY: Kwagura byatanze raporo y'uru rubuga hakiri kare cyane ugereranyije n'igihe rwagombaga kumara rugaragara. Mugenzure niba itariki n'igihe bya mudasobwa yanyu bishyirwaho mu buryo bwikora.
ext.why.GONE: Kwagura byatanze raporo y'uru rubuga bitinze cyane: kugaragaza byahagaze igihe kirekire.
ext.why.BLOCKED: Uburinzi bw'urubuga ntibwemereye kwagura gufungura urupapuro.
ext.why.TIMEOUT: Urubuga rwatinze cyane gufungura. Bishobora kuba ari urubuga rutinda cyangwa interineti idakomeye.
ext.update.ready: Verisiyo nshya ya PR Surf yarasohotse. Iyi yo ikomeza gukora kugeza ubu.
